title: chaetoseris lutea
intro: Chaetoseris lutea, commonly known as the yellow Chaetoseris, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is native to the mountainous regions of China. Chaetoseris lutea is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments and exhibits numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anticancer activities.
